summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A. (NYSE:IRS; BYMA:IRSA) filed a 6-K furnishing its notice of a General Ordinary and Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting called for October 22, 2026, held virtually at 11:00 a.m. first call and 12:00 p.m. second call. The agenda covers approval of FY2026 statements showing a ARS 394.1 billion profit, distribution of up to ARS 211 billion in cash and/or in-kind dividends, board and supervisory committee compensation and elections, auditor appointments, and a merger by absorption of Tienda Los Gallegos S.A. and Los Gallegos Martinez Navarro y Cia S.A. into IRSA. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms disclosed; the meeting must be registered with the CNV, BYMA, Caja de Valores and IGJ. What to watch: shareholder approval and registration of the dividend and the absorption merger, plus the timing of any distribution.
